goal: PG-403: cli_exit binds cli.main; rule exit_code_follows_audit_pass

responsibilities: Dispatch native commands, list module contracts and render declared model trees or Mermaid without running unrelated owners Expose testfile manifest/check/inspect/diff/snapshot/series; retired dataset and coverage commands are absent. run --json exposes the full diagnostic report. Preflight reviews optionally accept --audit; mapping review is part of hierarchy evaluate. Describe a declared tree as text, full JSON or Mermaid and count observed mappings per block without solving or evaluating; expose mapping-summary counts in observed summaries

hierarchy run, evaluate, compare and variants print the tree view by default and validation run a compact summary with check counts and assumption dispositions; each prints the full report with --json
Write manifest source paths relative to the output manifest directory while preserving stdout-only path behavior
Exit 0 on a passed check, 1 on a checked failure, and 2 when the command cannot run; comparison uses observed audit status
Inspect assumption cards from either a single SystemSpec or the system inside a hierarchical audit
Expose local/subtree verdicts, refinement consistency and per-template status in hierarchy summaries; pass the audit directory for file resolution
Run hierarchy variants with optional fault compositions and observed signature matching; expose masked pairs, next signals and model misses without changing nominal inputs
side_effects: Write explicitly requested native manifest, SI snapshot or series output files
